audit.root_cause: This V1 env pins `verifiers==0.3.2.dev121`. Our `verifiers>=0.4` install was rejected, so the harness fell back to `verifiers<0.4` and also switched to the V0 probe, which calls the legacy `vf.load_environment`. The README explicitly says that API doesn't exist in this release and to use the v1 `vf-eval mazebench --env.agent...` path.
audit.evidence: pyproject.toml: `verifiers==0.3.2.dev121`; README.md:52-58 `the old verifiers.load_environment() / legacy prime eval run evaluator is not this release's API`; mazebench/__init__.py exports only MazeBenchTaskset; result.json api=v0, runtime_label_mismatch=true, verifiers_version=0.3.2.dev121; probe error at probe.py:27 `vf.load_environment(env_id)`
audit.irl_fix: None needed for this failure (the README's v1 vf-eval path is the supported one). Minor: drop hatch_build.py from the wheel's top level, since importing it needs hatchling.
